svg.aria-label: Diagram: the same smoke mixes through about 860 m of air in May and June but only about 260 m in November
svg.text: Why the same smoke gets worse in November
Lahore's smoke mixes into a layer of air near the ground. In autumn and winter that layer gets much shallower.
smoke spreads through deep, stirred-up air
the same smoke is squeezed into a shallow layer
warmer air on top acts as a lid
crop fires on the city's edge
Same everyday smoke, spread through ~850 m
About 3× as concentrated*, plus crop smoke
*Idealized: the same emissions in a shallower layer, other factors held constant. Mixing heights: ERA5, monthly averages over all hours of the day,
central Lahore, 2019–2025 (May 858 m, June 825 m, November 262 m); nights are much shallower, afternoons deeper. HamariHawa (hamarihawa.org)
